body:
## What does this PR do?

Microsoft Teams **file send/receive**: personal DM FileConsent plus Graph/SharePoint upload and inbound attachment fetch for channel/group chats.

**Stacked on** https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/118102 — please **merge reactions first**. Until then, this diff vs `main` includes both commits; after reactions lands, only the files delta remains.

Fork source: https://github.com/tournierjc/hermes-agent/pull/2

### Files (outbound)

- **Personal (1:1):** FileConsentCard → OneDrive PUT → FileInfoCard (no Graph required).
- **Channel/group — small text:** inlined as a normal message.
- **Channel/group — binary:** app-only Graph upload into conversation `filesFolder`, then a SharePoint/`webUrl` link in the same chat. **No** channel base64 attachments (those 400).

### Files (inbound)

When Bot Framework only sends caption + unnamed `text/html`, Hermes GETs the Graph channel/chat message and downloads SharePoint attachments. Personal chats keep `file.download.info` / FileConsent.

### Graph setup

`MSGRAPH_*` (or same Entra app as `TEAMS_*`) with admin consent for:

- `Files.ReadWrite.All`
- `ChannelMessage.Read.Group` (RSC) or `ChannelMessage.Read.All`
- `ChatMessage.Read.Chat` (RSC) or `Chat.Read.All`

See Teams messaging docs + microsoft-graph-app-registration guide in-tree.

### Also

- Observe-unmentioned channel context (RSC)
- FileConsent Accept enum fix + card dismiss

## Type of Change

- [x] ✨ New feature
- [x] 📝 Documentation
- [x] ✅ Tests

## How to Test



Live (with Graph consented): attach a file in a channel @mention; ask the bot to send a `.docx` and expect a SharePoint link.
